subject: mn-di
title: MN.DI.------AF.COMP.
description: Chart on book p. 301 (PR.S(RD)II-55). MN-DI (mono-dimensional) is the subject; AF-COMP (affinity compression) is the partner. From the subject: LG-DY (logical dynamics), CULT-SOLD (culture solidification) and PER-DY (perception dynamics). From LG-DY: INFO-ALGN (information alignment) and IST-F-DT (isolated focus dictates). From IST-F-DT: LANG-DY (language dynamics). From PER-DY: EXTN-D (existential definition). From EXTN-D: INTL (intellectualism). From INTL: IST-F (isolated focus).
